The Mandarin MP3 clips in this directory were generated with the Kokoro-82M-v1.1-zh text-to-speech model (`hexgrad/Kokoro-82M-v1.1-zh`), distributed under Apache License 2.0.

Each filename is the unmarked pinyin spelling followed by its tone number, for example `ma3.mp3`. The clip speaks the associated example character or word listed in `src/voice-examples.js`; neutral-tone examples use contextual words.
